snippets.non_accrual: ain current. The Company may make exceptions to this treatment if an investment has sufficient collateral value and is in the process of collection. As of June 30, 2026, the Company had certain investments held in 10 portfolio companies on non-accrual status, which represented 5.0% and 2.9% of the total investments (excluding investments in money market funds, if any) at amortized cost and at fair value.

notes: No weighted-average risk rating found (many BDCs do not disclose one).
